name: kudesi-oa-next
description: 酷得斯 OA 新版：React + TypeScript + NestJS + MySQL 8

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @kudesi/api && npm run build -w @kudesi/web && npm run build -w @kudesi/agent
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @kudesi/api && npm run typecheck -w @kudesi/web && npm run typecheck -w @kudesi/agent
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm test -w @kudesi/shared && npm test -w @kudesi/api && npm test -w @kudesi/web && npm test -w @kudesi/agent
